title: Rolling and cutting tolerances for hot rolled parallel flange beam and column sections
clause_1_scope: This standard covers the rolling and cutting tolerances applicable to hot rolled steel parallel flange beam and column sections conforming to the dimensions specified in IS 12778 ; 1989.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Hot Rolled Parallel Flange Steel Sections for Beams, Columns and Bearing Piles - Dimensions and Section Properties

clause_3_terminology: Rolling and cutting tolerances for hot rolled parallel flange beam and column sections

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
